title: Inherited arcs in André planes of even order
summary: André planes of order $q^t$ can be constructed from the Desarguesian plane $PG(2,q^t)$ using a process that involves replacing André nets. This article constructs ovals in André planes of order $q^t$, $q$ even and $t$ prime that are inherited from conics of the Desarguesian plane $PG(2,q^t)$. Further, it is shown that certain conics do not inherit to arcs under the process of André replacement.
